description: Replace the person's mock-interview hosting settings as a whole: the time zone their schedule is in, the meeting link guests receive, the topics they offer, and whether hosting is paused. Returns the saved settings.

meeting_url.description: The https link guests join the call at.

paused.description: True stops new bookings; existing mocks stay.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the schedule's HH:MM times are in.

topics.description: Topics the person offers to interview on, at least one.
